create.name: Kate Belew
create.bio:
Kate Belew is a poet, author and teacher whose work joins creative writing with witchcraft and folk magic. She grew up in Michigan, studied English at Kalamazoo College and holds an MFA in poetry from Sarah Lawrence College. She trained in green witchcraft through a three-year apprenticeship with Robin Rose Bennett, studied herbalism with the Chestnut School of Herbs and astrology with Rebecca Gordon, and is an initiated Green Witch. She lives in Brooklyn.

She has led writing circles and workshops since 2017, in person and online. Her five-week programme The Bardo brings writers together for sessions on ritual, storytelling and channelled and automatic writing, and her Word Witch newsletter on Substack offers weekly essays and seven-line writing prompts, with live writing circles for paying members. Her book Word Witch (2025) is a guide to building a writing practice through simple rituals, and she co-wrote Wild Medicine, an illustrated guide to the folklore and magic of more than sixty herbs, with Shelby Bundy of Tamed Wild, where she co-hosted the Magick & Alchemy podcast. Her poems and essays have appeared in a range of journals and magazines.

books.title: Word Witch: How to Call Upon and Cultivate the Creative Magic Within You
books.author: Kate Belew
books.description: A guide to building a creative writing practice rooted in ritual and magic. It offers simple writing rituals and spells, ways to work with creative cycles and the seasons, and ideas for finding a supportive writing community.

books.title: Wild Medicine: An Illustrated Guide to the Magick of Herbs
books.author: Shelby Bundy, Kate Belew
books.description: An illustrated guide to more than sixty herbs, written with Shelby Bundy of Tamed Wild. Each entry gives a botanical description, historical and folk lore, and rituals and recipes for working with the plant.

courses.title: The Bardo
courses.description: A five-week, ten-session online writing programme for writers and 'Word Witches', run each winter with Kate and guest teachers. Sessions cover writing rituals, storytelling, creative ecology and channelled and automatic writing, with time to write and share work.

courses.title: Word Witch Paid Subscription
courses.description: A paid tier of her Substack newsletter with the full archive, monthly live writing circles, seasonal writing prompts guided by astrology and a subscriber chat.
courses.price: $7 USD a month or $77 USD a year

free_resources.title: Word Witch Newsletter
free_resources.description: Her free weekly Substack newsletter, running since 2020, with essays on creativity and magic, interviews and a seven-line writing prompt each week.
